description:
Duties & Responsibilities: 
 The ability to work with limited supervision at client site and the ability to make decisions regarding assigned projects independently or with limited direction from management.
 
 Team Player – Enthusiastic, personable, works well with others (including an offshore team) 
 Logical Thinker – Ability to perform analysis and research 
 Self starter / motivator. Takes initiative and is willing to learn. Should be able to share knowledge effectively in the team. 
 Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.  - This is a MUST  
 Microsoft Office knowledge (Word, Excel, Visio) 
 Teamsite Experience is a MUST. More specifically Teamsite 7.3.1 
 Provide training sessions for offshore/onshore on Teamsite 7.3.1 and Templating Process. 
   
 Primary Interwoven TeamSite Templating skills: 
 Creating a New Data Content Record (DCR) 
 Generating an Output File 
 Setting up Data Capture Templates 
 Setting up Presentation Templates 
 Mapping Users, Templates, and Content Records 
 Integrating Templating, DataDeploy, and Workflow. 
   
 Secondary Skills: 
 Perl (as Teamsite uses Perl too) 
 Unix/Shell Script 
 Java 
 XML
 

 Apply today!
